Name: Pelican Post
Author: xDessky
Description:
Pelican Post turns the farmhouse mailbox into a clean, vanilla-style post office without hiding the game behind a separate full-screen interface.

OVERVIEW
Browse every waiting letter from one place, preview its contents, see what kind of reward it contains, and decide whether to read it normally or process it immediately. Money, quests, recipes, and item rewards use Stardew Valley's own mail handling so vanilla and modded letters stay compatible.

MAIN FEATURES
• Vanilla-inspired popup interface that keeps the game visible in the background.
• Inbox with letter titles, senders, previews, unread status, and reward icons.
• One-click reward claiming without opening every letter.
• Process All option for handling the entire inbox at once.
• Money, items, recipes, quests, special orders, and mail actions are supported.
• Packages tab safely stores rewards that do not fit in your inventory.
• Archive tab keeps processed letters readable afterward.
• Recovered-item letters are opened normally to preserve upgrades and enchantments.
• Mouse, keyboard, and controller support.
• Configurable preview and visible-letter settings through Generic Mod Config Menu.
• Full localization for every language supported by Stardew Valley.

INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer.
2. Extract the PelicanPost folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

REQUIREMENTS
• Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer.
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer.
• Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

CONTROLS
• Mouse: select letters, tabs, and actions normally.
• Keyboard: arrow keys or WASD to navigate, Enter to confirm, R to read, Escape to close.
• Controller: D-pad or left stick to navigate, A to confirm, X to read, shoulder buttons to change tabs.

TEST COMMANDS
• pelicanpost_test [1-6] — adds localized test letters.
• pelicanpost_open — opens the post office menu.
• pelicanpost_clear_test — removes Pelican Post test letters.

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES
English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Simplified Chinese.

COMPATIBILITY AND SAFETY
Pelican Post uses the game's native letter parser for rewards, recipes, quests, special orders, and trigger actions. Inventory overflow is stored per save. Collect any waiting packages before removing the mod.

Created for players who want a faster mailbox while keeping Stardew Valley's cozy, familiar style.
